scope: Local optional authored-model archive and derived static NPC LOD library. No production activation.

preservation.sources: Exact original authored source bytes, content addressed. Every available source snapshot is retained.
preservation.preview: Exact original opaque neutral-preview JSON bytes, including normals, indices, matrices, groups, materials and metadata; lossless array-object decomposition deduplicates repeated geometry.
preservation.exclusions: Original exporter omits transparent effects and invisible shadow proxies. Those are preserved in original sources when available. NPC LODs deliberately simplify geometry and replace the original material set with six shared opaque materials.
preservation.lineage: Git entries record exact parents and full commits. Frozen entries retain their original source hashes and path; matching hashes link source snapshots. Geometry signatures exclude normals and materials; appearance signatures include them.
